name: World of Pannotia: Husks Drop Sand
summary: Husks, parched and camel husks drop sand in addition to their normal drops, and Looting increases the amount.

mechanics.title: Sand drops
mechanics.description: Unconditional pool (no player-kill requirement) on top of vanilla drops. Husk: 0-2 sand, +0-1 per Looting level. Parched: 0-2 sand, +0-1 per Looting level. Camel Husk: 0-3 sand, +0-2 per Looting level.

editor_notes: Counts are uniform integer ranges starting at 0. These mobs also have a head drop in more_mob_heads.
